title: Encaustic cement tiles with symmetric inlay motifs
purpose: Generate tileable PBR maps of encaustic cement tiles: inlaid colour motifs with the eightfold symmetry of the square (stars, florals, nested geometry, rosettes in frames) whose edge shapes join across tiles, on matte cement with pores and wear. Use for kitchens, bathrooms and cafe floors.

contract.signature: generate(width=256, height=256, seed=0, preset="default", directx_normal=False, **parameters) -> {map name: {"channels", "colour_space", "pixels"}}
contract.command_line: python encaustic_cement_tiles.py --size 1024 --seed 7 --preset NAME --out DIR [--width W --height H] [--set NAME=VALUE] [--directx-normal] [--orm]

parameters.name: tiles_across
parameters.meaning: Tiles across the tile width (and height).

parameters.name: family
parameters.meaning: Motif family: 0 eight-point star with corner circles, 1 floral with axis and diagonal petals, 2 geometric nested squares and diamonds, 3 rosette inside a border frame.

parameters.name: motif_variant
parameters.meaning: Which design of the family: sizes and proportions of its shapes.

parameters.name: joint_width
parameters.meaning: Joint between tiles in tile widths.

parameters.name: edge_softness
parameters.meaning: Width in pixels over which inlay colours blend at their boundaries.

parameters.name: wear
parameters.meaning: Faded, scuffed patches and slightly chipped tile edges.

parameters.name: pores
parameters.meaning: Small pores and air holes in the cement face.

parameters.name: hue_shift
parameters.meaning: Hue rotation of the albedo in turns.

presets.name: default
presets.description: Eight-point stars in black and terracotta on cream with ochre corner circles.

presets.name: blue_floral
presets.description: White tiles with cobalt and sky blue petals around a small centre.

presets.name: geometric_mono
presets.description: Black, white and grey nested squares and diamonds, four tiles per side.

presets.name: rosette_border
presets.description: Faded green, rose and sand rosettes framed by a border band, well worn.

limits: Motifs come from four families of simple shapes (stars, discs, rings, petals, squares, diamonds, frames) varied by motif_variant; free-form floral drawing and real catalogue patterns are out of scope. Every tile carries the same motif, so layouts that rotate or alternate tiles are not produced. Inlay colours are flat with softened boundaries; wear and pores are noise approximations. Occlusion is a blurred-height estimate, not ray traced.
technique_references: Folding a point into one octant of the square for D4 symmetry
Painter's-order signed-distance layers: polar star, discs, rings, ellipse petals, Chebyshev squares, Manhattan diamonds
Mirror-symmetric edges so corner and edge shapes join across tiles
Smoothstep coverage for softened inlay boundaries
Fractional Brownian motion for faded wear
Height to tangent-space normal by central differences
